title: Siri
hint: Create an Assistant Token for each device that talks to your lists by voice. A token can add to your lists, tick off items already on your Shopping List, and read your Pantry and Shopping List to answer questions, and nothing else; revoke it here to stop it right away.

reveal.title: Copy your token now
reveal.hint: This is the only time it is shown. Paste it into the Shortcut when asked.

loadFailed: Your tokens could not be loaded.
revokeConfirm: Revoke {{name}}? Anything using it stops working.

setup.title: Set up Siri
setup.create: Create a token above and copy it.
setup.add: Add the Shortcuts you want to the Shortcuts app.
setup.paste: Paste the token when the Shortcut asks for it.
setup.say: Say “Hey Siri” and a Shortcut’s phrase, then say what you need.
setup.language: Siri’s phrase is always English, but you can say the items in any language PantryGator supports.

needs.does: Adds what you say to your Shopping List.

got.does: Ticks off what you say if it is on your Shopping List. It never adds or removes anything, and it tells you when the item is not on the list.

have.phrase: Hey Siri, Gator, do we have
have.does: Answers whether you have an item in your Pantry, or whether it is on your Shopping List.
have.link: Open the “Gator, do we have” Shortcut

add.does: The first Shortcut. It still works: it adds to your Shopping List, and it answers questions too.
